title: Cursor monthly pool order
text: Cursor Models precedes Other Models in the shipped order. An absent universe_settings row reads that order. A stored row freezes it at write time; delete the row with a reviewed yoke operator data-repair to follow the shipped order again. Admins can reverse the two rows in Settings or replace the whole order with the registered CLI. This is universe-wide, not per machine; available Cursor candidates prefer the earlier pool before headroom.
recipes: yoke settings set cursor_quota_order '["Cursor Models", "Other Models"]'
evidence: Production QA run 45473 / artifact 32323 proves two rows and move controls; universe.cursor_quota_order.get reread 2026-10-13. Mutation and placement mechanics observed in source.
